summary: IMC Graduate Deep Learning Researcher is today's strongest newly discovered, explicitly 2027-compatible role: BS/MS research can be demonstrated through thesis, open-source work or projects, and the work includes modern deep learning plus shared training infrastructure. IMC Graduate Quantitative Researcher is a strong secondary hedge. Three live unlabeled roles at SpaceXAI and DRW are surfaced as high-value stretches because their distributed inference, scheduling and serving overlap is exceptional despite steep production-depth screens.
changes_today: NEW TODAY: IMC Graduate Deep Learning Researcher accepts BS/MS candidates starting in February or August 2027 and explicitly counts thesis, open-source contributions or projects as research evidence.
NEW TODAY: IMC Graduate Quantitative Researcher (BS/MS) is a clean May 2027-compatible research hedge with a $250,000 base salary and no professional-years minimum.

NEW TODAY / STRETCH: SpaceXAI RL Inference, SpaceXAI Evaluation Infrastructure and DRW AI Inference Platform are live official requisitions with unusually direct inference, scheduling and performance overlap but demanding production-depth expectations.
No new official Gmail offer, rejection, interview or assessment evidence was found; third-party alerts were not treated as application proof.

Frontier sweep rechecked official openings at OpenAI, Anthropic, SpaceXAI, DeepMind, Meta, NVIDIA, Microsoft, Amazon/Annapurna, Waymo, Databricks, Cerebras, Together, Fireworks and CoreWeave; senior/years-gated roles remained excluded.
